# Sirach Chapter 51 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic Equivalent)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 51 | **Date:** 2026-03-17

---

**51:1** I give you thanks, Lord and King; I praise you, God my Savior; I thank your name —

**51:2** for you have been my shield and helper, and saved my body from destruction, from the noose of a slanderous tongue, from lying lips; you stood up for me against those who opposed me,

**51:3** and in the fullness of your mercy and for your name's sake you rescued me from teeth grinding to devour me, from those who were hunting my life, from the many afflictions that came down on me,

**51:4** from smothering fire on every side, from the heart of fire that I had never kindled,

**51:5** from the pit of the belly of Hades, from a foul tongue and from lying words —

**51:6** lies told about me to the king by a treacherous tongue. My life nearly ended; I was on the edge of the pit.

**51:7** They hemmed me in on every side with no one to help; I looked for any human help — there was none.

**51:8** Then I remembered your mercy, Lord, and your deeds from ancient times — for you rescue those who put their hope in you and save them from their enemies.

**51:9** I lifted my prayer up from the earth and begged for rescue from death.

**51:10** I called on the Lord, Father of my lord: "Do not abandon me when trouble comes, when the arrogant oppress and there is no one to help.

**51:11** I will praise your name constantly, singing songs of thanksgiving." And my prayer was heard —

**51:12** for you pulled me back from destruction and rescued me from that terrible time. For this I will thank and praise you and bless the name of the Lord.

**51:13** When I was still young, before I had wandered anywhere, I sought wisdom openly, as I prayed.

**51:14** At the threshold of the temple I prayed for her; I will search for her to my last breath.

**51:15** From the blossom right to the ripe fruit, my heart delighted in her; my foot walked the straight path; I have been on her trail since my youth.

**51:16** I bent my ear just a little and received her; and I found for myself more instruction than I had imagined.

**51:17** I grew in her; to the one who gives wisdom I give the glory.

**51:18** For I decided to live by her, I was passionate for good, and I have not been disappointed.

**51:19** My whole being wrestled for her, and my effort confirmed me. I stretched my hands toward heaven and wept over how little I knew of her.

**51:20** I set my soul on her, and I found her in purity; from the first I gained understanding alongside her, so I will never be abandoned.

**51:21** My whole heart was restless until it found her; and so I have come to possess something truly precious.

**51:22** The Lord gave me my tongue as my reward, and I will use it to praise him.

**51:23** Come close, you uneducated ones! Make your home in the house of instruction.

**51:24** Why do you hold back — when your souls are dying of thirst?

**51:25** I opened my mouth: "Come, buy wisdom at no cost.

**51:26** Bow your neck under her yoke; let your soul be instructed. She is not far to find.

**51:27** See for yourselves: my effort was small, but the rest I found was vast.

**51:28** Get instruction the way you would invest in silver — and through her you'll gain far more than gold.

**51:29** May your soul rejoice in his mercy, and may you never blush with shame when you praise him.

**51:30** Do your work before the time runs out, and he will give your reward when the time is right."
